The '''Tourist Guild''' was the authority that controlled the resort [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Spira/Legends|Spira]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The Guild leased the planet from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], and under agreement with them, only authorized [[Passenger liner/Legends|passenger liners]], contracted supply [[Starship/Legends|starships]], and Imperial vessels were allowed to land on the planet.<ref name="TSR" />
